name: Atlas Data: Ads, Jobs & Trends
description: Competitor ad and market data for agents: Google Trends (interest over time, by region, related queries), Google Ads Transparency Center ads, LinkedIn Ad Library and TikTok Ad Library ads (text, creatives, landing pages, reach, impressions), and Google Jobs postings with parsed salary.
